title: Using Traits as Static Namespaces
pattern: Defining traits containing only static methods and no `self` receiver, used merely as a namespace.
why_bad: Confuses traits with modules, adding useless boilerplate.
detection: A trait with zero methods receiving `self`, `&self`, or `&mut self`.
counterexample: Factory traits designed to construct types.
fix: Move static functions to a standard module.
